business_profile.name: Civic Facilities Maintenance Ltd.
business_profile.business_type: municipal facility maintenance, minor repairs, electrical coordination, plumbing coordination, and preventative maintenance contractor

chunks.text: Bidders must provide proof of commercial general liability insurance. The bidder shall provide reference projects for similar municipal facility maintenance work.

The contractor shall perform preventative maintenance, minor repairs, electrical coordination, plumbing coordination, and after-hours service calls. Bidders must submit the completed Appendix C response form.
